exposure: maternal continuous glucose monitoring time in range (TIR)
cohort: The study included 81 pregnant women with Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) who had at least two in-house ultrasounds and delivered a live singleton neonate between December 2019 and December 2022.
finding: There was no cross-sectional relationship between maternal time in range (TIR) and fetal abdominal circumference (AC) in the third trimester, but first trimester TIR significantly predicted fetal AC at 32- and 36-weeks' gestation.
